newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Scitor unveils new name, pact with SingTel.
newsitem.headline: Scitor unveils new name, pact with SingTel.

text.p: Scitor Asia-Pacific, a data communications service provider, said on Monday it had reached an agreement with Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) to offer managed data communications services in Singapore.

The company, which has regional headquarters in Atlanta, London and Singapore, also announced a new corporate identity and the appointment of Colin Grenville as its president and chief executive officer for the Asia-Pacific and Australasia.
It said in a statement Scitor Asia-Pacific would now be called EQUANT Network Services Pte Ltd.
EQUANT's global business volume has doubled over the last three years and revenue for 1996 is expected to exceed US$200 million, with contract values reaching $500 million, the statement said.

EQUANT is jointly owned through a Dutch-registered holding company whose partners are SITA -- a co-operative of the world's air transport industry -- an employee trust, and Morgan Stanley Capital Partners and its co-investors.
